name: com.enochxii/the-password
title: THE PASSWORD — Club MCP (Store Zero)
description: Club MCP for THE PASSWORD: catalog, Paper Exchange, key check, floor and store tools.

tools.name: paper_quote
tools.description: Free. Live two-source price snapshot for the Paper Exchange (Kraken + Coinbase Exchange, named, spread printed). Simulated market data.

tools.name: paper_leaderboard
tools.description: Free. Public Paper Exchange leaderboard: per-wallet simulated trading results by season.

tools.name: paper_position
tools.description: Free. Mark a simulated Paper Exchange position: current price and unrealised P/L after the simulated fee model.

tools.name: catalog_search
tools.description: Free. Search Store Zero's catalog by keyword: the 147-work art catalog plus the store's digital-goods products (skill pack, Sound Bank volumes, AI Library editions). Every licensable work carries its live x402 purchase route and published tier prices; quote-only works carry no route; products carry their buy route and published price.

tools.name: catalog_sets
tools.description: Free. Computed license sets for the catalog: one set per kind at a published tier, priced at the exact sum of per-work prices (savings $0, stated). Sets are computed offers; per-work purchase routes are live beneath them.

tools.name: paper_trade
tools.description: Paid ($0.01 via x402, per the PaymentRequired payload). Open a SIMULATED position against live prices on the Paper Exchange. Returns the fill and an Ed25519-signed record.

tools.name: paper_close
tools.description: Paid ($0.01 via x402). Close a simulated Paper Exchange position; returns the full outcome record with risk metrics and a signed receipt.

tools.name: paper_replay
tools.description: Paid ($0.01 via x402). Historical replay fill: run one simulated trade over recorded Kraken candles (backtesting). Lands as a closed position with mode=replay.

tools.name: price_attestation
tools.description: Paid ($0.01 via x402). A two-source, spread-printed, Ed25519-signed price snapshot an agent can show its principal. Refuses (signed no_attestation) when sources disagree by more than 1%.

tools.name: buy_ai_library_reader
tools.description: Paid ($19 via x402, per the PaymentRequired payload). Buy The AI Library — Reader Edition: all 25 volumes / 190 briefs in full, personal use (Licence Terms v1.0). Settlement returns the signed receipt with its delivery URL; the edition zip is byte-identical to the Payhip deliverable and its SHA-256 is the receipt's asset_hash.

tools.name: buy_ai_library_complete
tools.description: Paid ($49 via x402, per the PaymentRequired payload). Buy The AI Library — Creator + Operator Complete Package: everything in the Reader Edition plus the worksheets pack, all 25 volume PDFs and the markdown copy, for use inside your own business and client work (Licence Terms v1.0). Settlement returns the signed receipt with its delivery URL; the edition zip is byte-identical to the Payhip deliverable and its SHA-256 is the receipt's asset_hash.

tools.name: buy_ai_library_team
tools.description: Paid ($149 via x402, per the PaymentRequired payload). Buy The AI Library — Team / Resale Licence: everything in the Complete Package plus two distinct permissions — internal team licensing (seats, workshops, teach-from-it) and redistribution/resale rights — spelled out in the included Licence Terms v1.0 document. Settlement returns the signed receipt with its delivery URL; the edition zip is byte-identical to the Payhip deliverable and its SHA-256 is the receipt's asset_hash.
